name: novacrm
description: Offline-ready multi-tenant CRM with built-in Node SQLite

scripts.check: node --check server.js && for f in src/*.js src/routes/*.js lib/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && for f in public/js/*.js public/js/pages/*.js; do node --input-type=module --check < $f || exit 1; done
